title: Clarify rich verbose MCP versus terse show boundary
outcome: The MCP schemas and documentation state one enforceable contract for terse show and verbose next/ls, without presenting an optional projection as a global safety boundary.
acceptance: Either verbose rich views are removed from agent MCP schemas or all contracts clearly scope identity/integrity omission to terse show.

Handoff labels are non-resolving display values and now refuse as unusable targets before writes. Actual tools/list and CLI help regressions plus all nine gates pass.
